decks.notes: The deck focuses on assembling a potent combo involving Underworld Breach, Grinding Station, and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to generate infinite mana and mill your opponent's entire library. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Mishra's Bauble provide card advantage and manipulation to help find key pieces. The deck also includes disruption in the form of countermagic and removal spells, as well as utility lands like Urza's Saga and Boseiju, Who Endures. Overall, the strategy revolves around efficiently cycling through your deck to set up a game-winning combo while disrupting your opponent's game plan.

This deck is focused on using Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Underworld Breach to continuously loop spells from the graveyard, enabling a powerful combo with Grinding Station and Mishra's Bauble to mill the opponent's library. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student also helps with card selection and recursion. The deck utilizes artifacts like Mox Opal and Urza's Saga for ramp and provides disruption with cards like Soul-Guide Lantern and Spell Snare. The goal is to set up the combo quickly and overwhelm the opponent with a barrage of spells and mill their entire deck.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly playing powerful creatures and spells to overwhelm the opponent. With cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer leading the charge, supported by removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment, the deck aims to control the board while dealing consistent damage. The inclusion of Static Prison and Arena of Glory helps to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect your creatures. Overall, this deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain momentum to secure a fast victory.

The deck revolves around utilizing Underworld Breach to repeatedly cast powerful spells from the graveyard, enabling a combo finish with cards like Thassa's Oracle and Grinding Station. The deck's strategy is to disrupt the opponent while setting up its combo pieces with card draw from Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Emry, Lurker of the Loch. Urza's Saga provides additional artifact synergy and utility, while Mox Opal and Mishra's Bauble help accelerate its game plan. The deck aims to control the board and win through a quick and explosive combo.

The main concept of this Modern 1 vs 1 Amulet Titan deck is to utilize the synergy between Amulet of Vigor, Primeval Titan, and other land ramp cards to quickly assemble the mana needed to cast powerful spells like Scapeshift and Green Sun's Zenith. The deck aims to tutor for key lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and utilize their abilities to deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent quickly. The inclusion of cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and Urza's Saga further enhance the deck's ability to generate mana and create advantageous board states.

This deck focuses on using Underworld Breach to repeatedly cast powerful spells from the graveyard, while also utilizing Urza's Saga to generate value and Urza lands to ramp up mana production. Emry, Lurker of the Loch helps to recur artifacts from the graveyard, while Grinding Station and Malevolent Rumble provide additional combo pieces to enable powerful plays. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student allows for card selection and manipulation, ultimately leading to a win condition with Thassa's Oracle or overwhelming the opponent with a strong board presence.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of targeted discard spells like Thoughtseize, counter magic like Force of Negation, and efficient removal like Fatal Push. The deck aims to protect its threats like Murktide Regent and Abhorrent Oculus while gradually grinding out advantage with card draw from spells like Consider and Thought Scour. By disrupting the opponent's game plan and out-valuing them in the long game, this deck seeks to maintain control of the board and eventually finish off the opponent.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively overwhelm the opponent with creatures like Archon of Cruelty, Troll of Khazad-dûm, Nethergoyf, and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck also utilizes cards like Persist and Detective's Phoenix to maintain pressure and card advantage. The deck includes a mix of removal spells including Fatal Push and Tarfire to control the board. Mishra's Bauble and Faithless Looting help to dig for key cards while Street Wraith provides additional card draw. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with cards like Arboreal Grazer and Amulet of Vigor to get Primeval Titan onto the battlefield. Once Primeval Titan is out, players can search for key lands like Vesuva and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to deal massive amounts of damage. The deck also utilizes Urza's Saga to create tokens and search for key artifacts like Amulet of Vigor. By assembling the right combination of lands and utilizing the deck's search and ramp abilities, players can quickly overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures and land-based combos.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures, burn spells, and disruptive cards. The deck aims to quickly put pressure on the opponent with powerful creatures like Phlage and Ragavan, while also using cards like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to deal direct damage. Static Prison and Thraben Charm help to control the board, while Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional support and value. The deck's mana base allows for consistent access to its powerful spells and abilities.

The deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing a mix of creatures and spells to apply pressure on the opponent. The key strategy is to quickly build a board presence with creatures like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ocelot Pride, while also using burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to control the board and finish off the opponent. Additionally, cards like Static Prison and Seasoned Pyromancer provide additional utility and card advantage to keep the pressure on. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of creatures, burn spells, and disruptive elements.

The deck focuses on using Underworld Breach and Grinding Station to repeatedly mill cards from the library and generate mana to cast spells from the graveyard. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student help to recur key pieces while Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal provide additional mana ramp. The deck aims to combo off quickly and win through a loop of milling and casting spells, ultimately finishing with Thassa's Oracle to win the game. The inclusion of disruptive spells like Unholy Heat and Sink into Stupor help to control the game while setting up the combo.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize cards like Underworld Breach and Grinding Station to combo off and win the game quickly. By using Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to recycle cards from the graveyard, along with Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal for additional mana acceleration, the deck aims to set up a loop that allows for infinite mill or damage to be dealt to the opponent. The inclusion of disruptive spells like Spell Pierce and Unholy Heat helps to protect the combo and ensure its success.

The deck aims to utilize the Underworld Breach combo to quickly mill through the library and win the game with Thassa's Oracle or Malevolent Rumble. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student help dig for combo pieces while Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal provide additional card advantage and ramp. The deck also includes disruption with Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Snare to protect the combo. Urza's Saga adds flexibility and toolbox options. Overall, the deck focuses on assembling the combo pieces efficiently and disrupting the opponent's game plan.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and graveyard disruption. By efficiently managing resources and controlling the board with powerful threats like Abhorrent Oculus and Psychic Frog, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize helps to handle threats early on, while cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Unearth provide additional value and card advantage. The deck's strategy revolves around maintaining control of the game and slowly grinding out a win.

The main focus of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using various mana accelerants and lands, and then cast powerful Eldrazi creatures to control the game. With the help of cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Kozilek's Command, the deck can disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up to play high-cost threats like Emrakul, the Promised End. The inclusion of cards like Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble also provides some board control and removal options. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures and disruptive spells.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Guide of Souls and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while using powerful spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm to control the board. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide additional threats and support. The deck also includes Ocelot Pride for token generation and Goblin Bombardment for direct damage. Seasoned Pyromancer helps with card advantage, while Static Prison and Blood Moon disrupt the opponent's strategy. The mana base is optimized for consistent access to all colors of mana.

The focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of low-cost aggressive creatures and powerful spells. The deck utilizes cards like Ocelot Pride and Guide of Souls to maintain a steady stream of threats, while also benefiting from the synergy between cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Seasoned Pyromancer. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah adds an extra element of control to the deck, with support from removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Static Prison. The deck also includes some versatile utility cards like Goblin Bombardment and Showdown of the Skalds to ensure a flexible gameplay style.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle. The deck focuses on putting pressure with early creatures like Guide of Souls and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, supported by removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm. It also includes cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Showdown of the Skalds for additional damage output. The key strategy is to maintain board presence and keep the opponent on the back foot, utilizing cards like Ocelot Pride and Goblin Bombardment for additional reach.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to establish an early board presence with efficient creatures like Guide of Souls and Ocelot Pride, backed up by burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to finish off the opponent. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and other pump spells like Thraben Charm and Seasoned Pyromancer help increase the damage output, while disruptive cards like Static Prison and Blood Moon can disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mix of creatures, burn, and disruption, this deck aims to win through fast and consistent damage.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays combined with burn spells to quickly defeat the opponent. By utilizing efficient creatures like Guide of Souls and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with powerful finishers like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its fast-paced strategy. The inclusion of cards like Static Prison and Thraben Charm helps to control the battlefield, while cards like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment provide additional reach and removal options. Overall, this deck aims to win through early aggression and efficient removal.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent using aggressive creatures like Guide of Souls, Ocelot Pride, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. By using powerful combat tricks like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm, alongside efficient removal spells like Chained to the Rocks and Surgical Extraction, the deck aims to maintain board control and push for a fast victory. Additionally, cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Goblin Bombardment provide additional reach and ways to close out games, while cards like Arena of Glory and Static Prison help to protect our board state and maintain aggression.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize Underworld Breach alongside artifacts and spells to create a powerful combo engine that can quickly mill through the deck, generate mana, and eventually win the game through Grapeshot or Malevolent Rumble. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student help to recur key pieces while cards like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal provide additional resources. Urza's Saga can generate tokens and tutor for important artifacts, while cards like Grinding Station and Mox Amber help to further fuel the combo.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the Underworld Breach combo to loop spells from the graveyard, utilizing artifacts like Mox Opal, Mishra's Bauble, and Grinding Station for card advantage and mana. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Urza's Saga help with recursion and tutoring, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides additional card selection. The deck aims to draw through the deck rapidly with card filtering and can win the game by casting Thassa's Oracle or overwhelming the opponent with Malevolent Rumble. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Spell Pierce to control the game tempo.

This deck focuses on utilizing Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Underworld Breach to create an infinite combo loop with Grinding Station and Mishra's Bauble, allowing you to mill your opponent's entire deck. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Malevolent Rumble help to dig for combo pieces, while Urza's Saga provides additional utility. The deck also includes disruptive elements such as Spell Pierce and Portable Hole to disrupt your opponent's game plan. Overall, this deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game through a powerful synergistic engine.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful synergies between cards such as Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Underworld Breach to create explosive combos that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. By combining artifact recursion with card draw and mana acceleration, the deck aims to set up a winning board state and potentially win the game with cards like Thassa's Oracle. The inclusion of disruptive elements like Unholy Heat and Malevolent Rumble helps to control the game and protect the combo pieces while Urza's Saga provides additional consistency and utility.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach along with a combination of artifacts and creatures to continuously cast spells from the graveyard. The key strategy involves using cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to generate value and set up combos with cards like Grinding Station and Mishra's Bauble. The deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard, loop spells with Urza's Saga, and ultimately win with a combo finish using Thassa's Oracle or Haywire Mite. It heavily relies on synergy between the different cards to execute its game plan efficiently.

The deck focuses on utilizing Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Underworld Breach to constantly recur artifacts from the graveyard to create a grinding combo engine. It aims to mill through the deck quickly while generating mana through Mox Opal and Mox Amber to eventually win the game with Thassa's Oracle or Grinding Station. The deck also includes disruptive elements like malevolent rumble and spell pierce to protect the combo. The key strategy is to cycle through the deck efficiently and disrupt opponents to assemble the combo pieces for a game-winning sequence.

This deck focuses on casting spells with Cascade to put multiple threats onto the battlefield quickly. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Ardent Plea, the deck can cascade into powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Crashing Footfalls. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Force of Negation and Subtlety to control the board while overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures. Additionally, Leyline Binding provides additional utility by tapping down opponents' creatures. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's multicolor requirements for Cascade spells.

This Esper Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy with a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. By controlling the board and manipulating the opponent's resources, it aims to outlast the opponent and secure victory through incremental advantages. The deck includes spells like Counterspell, Fatal Push, and Thought Scour to disrupt the opponent's plans, while also utilizing creatures like Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog to pressure the opponent and provide additional utility. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting spells.

The deck focuses on quickly cycling through cards and putting creatures into the graveyard to eventually cast Living End, a powerful sorcery that reanimates all creatures from the graveyard. The deck includes various creatures with cycling abilities, as well as cards that can put creatures in the graveyard without casting them. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a sudden board presence after casting Living End, potentially winning the game in just one turn. The deck also includes counterspells and support cards to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on stalling the game and controlling the opponent's board through counterspells and removal spells, while ramping up to play powerful Eldrazi creatures. The key strategy is to assemble Urza's lands, known as UrzaTron, in order to generate large amounts of mana quickly and cast game-winning threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. Karn, the Great Creator also plays a crucial role in shutting down opponent's artifacts and locking them out of the game. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with massive threats while maintaining control over the game.
